Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Poems, Songs and Tongue Twisters and finger fumblers
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Poems, Songs and Tongue Twisters and finger fumblers, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: Which poems and songs do you know? 2. How do you tell the meaning of unfamiliar words while reading and sign reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Poems, Songs and Tongue Twisters and finger fumblers together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: Articulating signs clearly as learners fingerspell and sign words related to the theme.

● Digital Literacy: Interacting with digital devices as learners are guided to watch a signed video using a digital device, on environmental

pollution.

● Learning to Learn: Developing relationships as learner role plays events or characters in the poem.

Values:
Responsibility: Hardwork as learners answer factual and inferential questions on the poem and song they have sign read.

Link to other Subjects:

The learners are able to relate the concept of songs and poems in English to their learning in Music and creative arts.
